### Contributing guidelines

- [x] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] I have read [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- [x] I have updated 'mini.nvim' to latest version of the `main` branch

### Module(s)

mini.snippets

### Neovim version

0.10.x

### Description

I'm encountering a couple of issues. 

First, there's a strange character appearing at the end of the line. 

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c6c6c61b-fb7d-4295-ae93-138d5f060068)

When I delete that line, I get this result:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0418c09d-14e0-45f4-8d23-42d22e6ccbfd)

The second issue I'm experiencing is related to snippets with capitalized parameters. They remain in lowercase. For example, in React, the `useState` hook should accept a value and a corresponding setter function. The setter function should use the same name as the value but prepend 'set' to it. So if the value is `test`, the setter function should be `setTest`, but instead, I'm getting `settest`. 

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1d3a0345-45d6-4266-8bbc-0c43f0322c3b)

### Reproduction

1. Create separate 'nvim-repro' config directory:
    - '~/.config/nvim-repro/' on Unix
    - '~/AppData/Local/nvim-repro/' on Windows

2. Inside 'nvim-repro' directory create a file named 'init.lua'.
   Populate it with the following content:

    ```lua
    -- Clone latest 'mini.nvim' (requires Git CLI installed)
    vim.cmd('echo "Installing `mini.nvim`" | redraw')
    local mini_path = vim.fn.stdpath('data') .. '/site/pack/deps/start/mini.nvim'
    local clone_cmd = { 'git', 'clone', '--depth=1', 'https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim', mini_path }
    vim.fn.system(clone_cmd)
    vim.cmd('echo "`mini.nvim` is installed" | redraw')

    -- Make sure 'mini.nvim' is available
    vim.cmd('packadd mini.nvim')
    require('mini.deps').setup()

    -- Add extra setup steps needed to reproduce the behavior
    -- Use `MiniDeps.add('user/repo')` to install another plugin from GitHub
    ```

3. Run `NVIM_APPNAME=nvim-repro nvim` (i.e. execute `nvim` with `NVIM_APPNAME` environment variable set to "nvim-repro").
   Wait for all dependencies to install.

4. Replace this with description of interactive reproduction steps along with the behavior you observe.
   Feel free to include images/videos/etc, this helps a lot.

Note: after reporting the issue, it is safe (and even recommended for cleaner possible future bug reports) to remove 'nvim-repro' config from the system:
- Delete config directory ('~/.config/nvim-repro' on Unix).
- Delete data directory ('~/.local/share/nvim-repro' on Unix).
- Delete state directory ('~/.local/state/nvim-repro' on Unix).

comment_data.body:
Everything described is expected and documented.

> First, there's a strange character appearing at the end of the line.

This is [an inline visualization of the final tabstop](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/3ad46cdb7a51281e0024416023b56cf5c7909ae7/doc/mini-snippets.txt#L284-L287).

> When I delete that line, I get this result:

This does not error but [it is recommended to be careful here](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/3ad46cdb7a51281e0024416023b56cf5c7909ae7/doc/mini-snippets.txt#L1085-L1088). This also shows inline visualization for regular empty tabstop (bullet point). To remove them, [stop the session](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/3ad46cdb7a51281e0024416023b56cf5c7909ae7/doc/mini-snippets.txt#L1065-L1078).

> The second issue I'm experiencing is related to snippets with capitalized parameters. They remain in lowercase. For example, in React, the `useState` hook should accept a value and a corresponding setter function. The setter function should use the same name as the value but prepend 'set' to it. So if the value is `test`, the setter function should be `setTest`, but instead, I'm getting `settest`.

Variable and tabstop transformations [are not supported](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/3ad46cdb7a51281e0024416023b56cf5c7909ae7/doc/mini-snippets.txt#L51-L53) with default snippet expand.

title: snipperts: weird character at the end and no capitalize support
